title: Road traffic counts (hourly), Mobility Office
summary: Hourly vehicle counts per road counter, described in the catalog as counters near the monitoring stations. Each row is a counter code, an hour-start timestamp in local time, and a vehicle count. Catalog coverage starts 2021-01-01, is open-ended and refreshes hourly (last refreshed 2026-10-12), with about 15 million rows. The wiki records a change in counting method on 2024-03-18 (per-direction counts before, combined after) that the catalog does not mention.

schema.notes: No counter coordinates, direction field, or counter-to-station mapping is documented. The wiki says counts were per direction before 2024-03-18 and combined after, but no direction column is listed in the catalog.

spatial.code_system: counter_id codes (free code, no geocoding documented)
spatial.notes: Local city data for Valdena. The catalog gives no counter locations, so proximity to monitoring stations cannot be verified from the catalog.

ownership.steward: Named steward listed in catalog (individual name omitted)

licence.name: internal
licence.evidence: get_catalog_entry internal.traffic.hourly_counts: classification 'internal'; no licence field present

documentation_excerpts: Counts per direction before 2024-03-18; both directions combined from 2024-03-18 (wiki counter_replacement_2024, last_edited 2024-04-02).
'Do not compare counts across the change without adjusting for it. The catalog entry for traffic.hourly_counts has no note about this.' (wiki counter_replacement_2024)
'Vehicles counted per hour by road counters near the monitoring stations.' (catalog description)
quality_notes: Catalog vs wiki disagreement: the wiki page counter_replacement_2024 (last_edited 2024-04-02) states the road counters were replaced on 2024-03-18 and the counting basis changed from per-direction to both-directions-combined. The catalog entry (catalog_exported_at 2026-10-14) has no note on this change.
The wiki does not state how the pre-change per-direction counts should be converted to the combined basis, so the adjustment method is undocumented.
No documentation of missing or outage hours. The vehicles column has no stated sentinel or zero convention; whether outages appear as zero is unknown and was not checked (no sample was read).
ts_local is local time with no UTC offset or DST rule documented; alignment with UTC air-quality data needs a DST-aware conversion.
No counter-to-monitoring-station mapping or counter coordinates documented, so the 'near the monitoring stations' claim in the catalog description cannot be verified.
Sample not possible: internal warehouse source accessed by request only. No data values were profiled.
